patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: They're back — same two guys, same argument, same as always. It's not new. I ran out of my risperidone about three weeks ago and I'd like to get back on it.
clinical.presentationShort: 31yo M, known schizophrenia — off risperidone 3 weeks, baseline auditory hallucinations returned. Calm, no SI/HI.
clinical.presentationLong: 31-year-old male with known schizophrenia, off risperidone for three weeks with return of his baseline auditory hallucinations; calm, cooperative, denies any thoughts of harm.

diagnosis.primary: Schizophrenia relapse due to medication non-adherence
diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: medically stable and low risk with no ED resources expected; Psych is preferred, and Fast Track is acceptable.
diagnosis.disposition: Psych → psychiatric evaluation, restart antipsychotic, arrange outpatient follow-up
diagnosis.why: Known diagnosis, familiar voices, no danger to anyone, and he is asking for his medication back. That is the Psych lane precisely — stable behavioural care, not an emergency.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a black 31-year-old man in a plain jacket and jeans, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting calmly with hands folded in his lap
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a black 31-year-old man in a plain jacket and jeans, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting calmly with hands folded in his lap. Expression: tired and matter-of-fact, entirely composed. Clearly visible: calm settled posture; no agitation. Overall: stable, cooperative and comfortable. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
